item.title: LangGraph: Graph-Based Workflows for Complex Agents
item.description: Understand LangGraph, the graph-based extension of LangChain that brings explicit control, branching logic, and stateful execution to complex AI workflows.

item.title: LangChain: The All-Purpose Toolkit
item.description: A comprehensive guide to LangChain, the flexible framework that provides building blocks for LLM applications with extensive tools, memory, and integrations.

item.title: CrewAI: Multi-Agent Teams Made Easy
item.description: Discover CrewAI, the framework purpose-built for orchestrating teams of AI agents that collaborate through roles, tasks, and structured processes.

item.title: AutoGen: Asynchronous Multi-Agent Conversations
item.description: Explore AutoGen, Microsoft's framework for asynchronous multi-agent conversations that emphasizes messaging protocols, parallelism, and dynamic task flows.

item.description: Building GenAI: The Orchestration Framework Maze: LangChain vs LlamaIndex vs Semantic Kernel vs CrewAI (and More)

item.title: What is Generative AI? A Practical Introduction
item.description: A hands-on introduction to Generative AI for engineers. Learn what makes GenAI different from traditional software, run your first API call, and understand why these systems behave the way they do.

item.title: The Generative AI Landscape: Models, Players, and Platforms
item.description: A practical tour of the generative AI ecosystem, from the big model families (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama) to the companies behind them, and how you actually access this stuff. APIs vs. open-source, closed vs. open philosophies, and what matters when you're picking a model for real work.

item.title: Key Concepts and Terminology for the Applied Engineer
item.description: Master the core vocabulary of generative AI including tokens, context windows, embeddings, temperature, hallucinations, and the fine-tuning vs. RAG debate. Practical definitions with gotchas from the trenches.

item.title: Stop Feeding HTML to LLMs - markdown.new
item.description: You're wasting 97% of your LLM tokens on HTML garbage. markdown.new strips it down to what matters. Here's the data, the architecture, and why the web needs a new content type for AI agents.

item.title: The Rise of Product Engineering
item.description: AI is separating coders from engineers. Real engineering is cross-functional product thinking, not staying inside frontend or backend labels.
